items.title: Millionaires Tax Passes Council 50-0, Weeks After Voters Give It Overwhelming Approval
items.description: The symbolic vote calls on the state to adopt the tax, which 80 percent of Chicago voters backed in the Nov. 3 election.

items.title: Ag School Students Serve Up Thanksgiving Dinner They Grew For Seniors
items.description: Students at the Chicago High School for Agricultural Sciences are involved in every step of the meal, from raising the turkeys to harvesting pumpkins they bake into pie.

items.title: Morgan Park Residential Development To Break Ground This Winter
items.description: Construction is expected to start in late January on the first six homes of Arlio Development’s project on Vincennes Avenue.

items.title: ‘Love Language’ Is The Rare 21st-Century Rom-Com Filmed Entirely In Chicago
items.description: The romantic comedy starring Chloë Grace Moretz, Anthony Ramos, Manny Jacinto and Billie Lourd was recently released in select theaters and on streaming services.

items.title: Chicago Principals’ Historic Contract Deal Would Boost Pay And Protections Against Harassment
items.description: The union and district said a deal reached last week would grant school leaders 3 percent cost-of-living raises each year through 2028-2029 and strengthen protections against harassment and threats.

items.title: The Bagelers To Bring ‘Chicago-Style’ Bagels To Logan Square
items.description: This is the second location of Sarah Flosi’s Lincoln Park business specializing in hand-rolled, kettle-boiled bagels — not to be confused with Tilly's sourdough bagels, also dubbed “Chicago-style.”

items.title: This Video Store On Wheels Is A Horror Movie Fan’s Dream
items.description: A Bridgeport-based couple is behind Night Natalie Video, a mobile video  store selling VHS tapes, DVDs, analog media players and cult-movie-inspired art.

items.title: Visions Cafe, A Brunch And Coffee Spot, Opens In North Lawndale
items.description: RRM Visions Cafe opened Monday, converting a vacant three-story building into a restaurant with event space and further community investment opportunities for a North Lawndale developer.
